events.title: Proposed ruling: escalate (model confidence 0.82)
events.body: Per SAFE-2, a case involving an allegation of dangerous driving — speeding, hard braking, overtaking on the shoulder, which the rider says made her feel unsafe — must not receive an automatic ruling; the case is escalated for a human reviewer with a factual summary [F1][F2] (complaint text in case file) [SAFE-2]. The trigger here does not depend on GPS: the ride record itself is unremarkable and cannot confirm or refute the manner of driving — actual distance 10.6 km vs optimal 10.7 km (-0.1 km, -1%) and duration 16.1 min vs 16 min estimated (-0.4 min) — so the physical trace is consistent with a normal, non-deviating trip and yields no route-deviation issue under RD-1/RD-2 [F1][F2][RD-1][RD-2]. In addition, the driver's post-trip statement calls the rider "stupid", which is hostile language aimed at the other party and therefore abuse under SAFE-1's code of conduct, making the safety concern at least suspected independently of the driving allegation [F6][SAFE-1]. Both an unsafe-driving allegation and an abusive remark fall outside automatic adjudication, so the outcome is escalate under the allowed-outcome trace [SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We're not deciding your dispute automatically. Because you reported dangerous driving — speeding, hard braking and overtaking on the shoulder — a Ryde Trust & Safety reviewer will look at your complaint and the trip record before anything is decided. The trip record shows a normal route and timing, so it can't confirm or rule out how the car was driven; that's for the reviewer to weigh along with what you described. No refund or fare change has been made on the $24.76 fare while the review is open. Nothing is needed from you right now.

DRIVER: We're not deciding this dispute automatically. A Ryde Trust & Safety reviewer will look at the rider's dangerous-driving allegation and your post-trip comment about the rider, which our conduct rules treat as abuse. The trip record shows a normal route and timing, so it doesn't settle how the car was driven — the reviewer will weigh that alongside the statements. No fare adjustment has been made on the $24.76 fare while the review is open, and no payout or fee action is being taken yet. Your account stays active during the review; we'll contact you if the reviewer needs anything.
